This is an infrastructure-heavy backend role at the intersection of software engineering and production infrastructure. You’ll develop Go services, contribute to customer-facing systems, improve reliability and performance, and learn how production infrastructure supports a broader artifact platform. Experience with Go, or strong programming experience in another language and the ability to learn Go quickly.
